en: The image shows a classic black-and-white view of a European baroque cityscape, dominated by ornate towers and large stone buildings along a river. A stone arch bridge crosses the river and riverboats or steamers can be seen on the water. The architecture is highly ornate and suggests royal or governmental buildings, with prominent spires and a large cathedral-like structure.
